description: A named machine that is not the reference host, prepared for a run: no throttling, clean sources, background load bounded. Its figures are labelled with the machine and compared within one report only (ADR 0025's note of 2026-11-10). Adjusted in the lab on 8 October 2026 because macOS idle maintenance keeps a resting Mac above the first thresholds: foreign CPU 150 % (was 50 %) excluding the agent app that drives the run, load per CPU 0.35 (was 0.25). Mains power is not required: on Apple Silicon the battery alone does not throttle, low-power mode does, and that gate stays.
